# ssp_ndr_config (Resource)

Manages pre-deployment configuration for **NSX NDR** (Network Detection & Response) on the SSP platform.

Controls cloud threat intelligence data sharing settings.

This is a singleton resource — use `terraform import ssp_ndr_config.this singleton` to adopt an existing configuration.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/lcm/ndr/config`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_sharing` (Boolean) Flag controlling whether NDR shares detection data to cloud for threat intelligence.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `singleton` for this resource.
- `revision` (Number) Revision number maintained by the SSP backend.
